# Data Model

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Not applicable in this repository (persistence)

No database driver, ORM, migrations directory, or schema files exist in `package.json` dependencies or the repo tree — `grep` for `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `IndexedDB`, and `cache` across `src/` returns no matches. The widget is stateless across page loads: every lead is built in-memory per submission and handed to the merchant's external webhook (`src/integrations/webhook.js:postLead`); the repo owns no storage layer.

### Cache (in-memory widget state)

No cache layer exists, but `LeadWidget` (`src/ui/widget.js`) holds transient in-memory instance state for the lifetime of the page:

| Field | Holds | Reset/lifecycle |
|---|---|---|
| `this.context` | Current lead context (`{ type: 'global' \| 'produto', ... }`) | Reassigned on every `open(context)` call (`src/core/context.js:createGlobalContext`/`readProductContext`) |
| `this.isOpen` | Panel open/closed boolean | Toggled by `open()`/`close()` |
| `this.root`, `this.button`, `this.panel`, `this.form`, `this.errors` | DOM node references created once in `mount()` | Set once per `mount()` call; `mount()` first removes any existing `#wpp-lead-widget-root` node to avoid duplicate mounts (`this.doc.getElementById(this.config.widgetRootId)?.remove()`) |

- No values persist beyond the browser tab/session — a page reload clears all state; nothing is written to disk, cookies, or storage APIs.
